name: serverdoctor
author: Taako
description: Read-only Discord server diagnostics for dangerous default permissions, bot capability gaps, role hierarchy, approaching platform limits, inaccessible channels, empty roles, duplicate role names, and optional TaakosCogs configuration checks.
install_msg: Run `[p]serverdoctor scan` to create a read-only health report.
short: Read-only server configuration and bot permission diagnostics.
end_user_data_statement: This cog stores ignored and previous finding codes, scheduling configuration, a report channel ID, scan timestamps, schema version, and aggregate severity counts. It does not store member IDs, message content, role membership, channel history, or full scan reports.
